case_name: Smt. Sudipa Das vs Sri Kausik Podder @ Tinku Podder

parties.respondent_defendant: Respondent-husband, Sri Kausik Podder @ Tinku Podder

facts_of_case: The petitioner filed an application for maintenance which was dismissed by the trial court. The petitioner's marriage was solemnized in 2011 and they have a child together. The husband allegedly subjected the wife to physical and mental torture after she couldn't fulfill his demand of Rs.2,00,000/-.

legal_principles.principle: The principle of natural justice was violated when the petitioner was not allowed to cross-examine the witnesses of the OP-husband.
legal_principles.held: Even the petitioner was not allowed to cross- examine the witnesses of the OP-husband. Thus, the principle of natural justice was violated.

legal_principles.principle: The court should not dismiss an application for maintenance without considering the evidence on record.
legal_principles.held: So, Learned Counsel urged for setting aside the judgment and to allow the application for maintenance filed by the petitioner.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's judgment dismissing the application for maintenance was upheld.
